abstract: Maintains media broadcast studio allocations, satellite transmission links, and journalist credential capacities
system_message:
You are the International Press Centre Director (IPB), responsible for maintaining media broadcast studio allocations, satellite transmission links, journalist credential capacities, and simultaneous translation infrastructure for international diplomatic summits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Simultaneous translation booths（TRANS）
information_points.content:
IPB-TRANS-0SL：Facilities audits for Harbourview International Expo Centre verify a total of 16 ISO-compliant interpretation booths serving the plenary and primary committee rooms.
IPB-TRANS-WN5：Audiovisual assessments show that Montague Sovereign Hall maintains 12 ISO-compliant interpretation booths across its main committee rooms and plenary chamber.
IPB-TRANS-M74：An audiovisual facilities audit confirms that Pacific Crown Convention Centre features 8 ISO-compliant interpretation booths across its plenary and main committee rooms.

information_points.title: Maintains media broadcast studio allocations, satellite transmission links, and journalist credential capacities（MEDA）
information_points.content:
IPB-MEDA-ZLK：The international broadcasting center at Harbourview International Expo Centre features a broadcast media workstation capacity of 200 workstations with gigabit fiber connectivity.
IPB-MEDA-UAE：According to the media center specifications, Pacific Crown Convention Centre provides a broadcast media workstation capacity of 120 workstations equipped with dedicated gigabit uplinks in its main international broadcasting center.
IPB-MEDA-X7Z：Montague Sovereign Hall offers a broadcast media workstation capacity of 160 workstations with dedicated fiber uplinks in its main broadcasting center.
